name: quality-barcelona
input: Quiero ir a Barcelona en marzo, 5 dias, saliendo de Buenos Aires
expected_output: A trip proposal for Barcelona: a flight from Buenos Aires (e.g. Iberia/Level/Lufthansa), a hotel in Barcelona (e.g. Hotel Gotico, Apartments Eixample or Barcelona Beach Hostel), and a day-by-day itinerary featuring real highlights such as the Sagrada Familia, Park Guell, the Gothic Quarter, La Rambla and Barceloneta beach.

input: Planificame un viaje a Lisboa de 3 dias saliendo de Buenos Aires
expected_output: A trip proposal for Lisbon: a flight from Buenos Aires (e.g. TAP or Iberia), a hotel in Lisbon (e.g. Hotel Alfama Terrace or Baixa Guesthouse), and a day-by-day itinerary featuring real highlights such as the Belem Tower, the Jeronimos Monastery, the Alfama district, Tram 28 and a day trip to Sintra.
